title: Līloa Drive extension in Kīhei
summary: As of September 2026, the department says the first phase of the Līloa Drive extension should begin in 2027. As of December 2024, the project had a $25 million federal grant and a draft environmental assessment, but cost had risen to $72 million and 13 of 38 affected property owners had not signed permit letters. The committee deferred the item.
